gaps.sentence: She left the room without ___ goodbye.
Remember ___ your passport to the airport.
gaps.explanation: remember + to-infinitive = not forget to do something.
hope takes the to-infinitive: hope to hear.

gaps.sentence: I could hear the neighbours ___ again last night.
gaps.explanation: hear + object + -ing = hear an action in progress: hear them arguing.

gaps.sentence: They agreed ___ the fence between the two gardens.
gaps.explanation: agree takes the to-infinitive: agreed to mend.

gaps.sentence: They made me ___ for the whole team's mistake.
gaps.explanation: make + object + bare infinitive in active sentences: made me apologise.
seem/appear take the to-infinitive: seems to know.
